primaryEvidence.publisher: Tunisian Ministry of Equipment, Housing and Territorial Planning; DGAT; URAM2018

reviewedPages.finding: Treats Essaada and Ettataouer as sectors on the periphery of the city of Jendouba.
Discusses Jendouba North and South as separate delegations and tabulates Jendouba and Jendouba North as separate administrative rows.
Proposes strengthening Jendouba as a regional city, with urban rail, economic and service functions.

primaryEvidence.limits: The resumed report supports an inhabited city identity distinct from the two administrative delegations. No exact town perimeter, population or coordinate is imported. The larger Rapport URL supplied as a lead was not used as this cached file source.

primaryEvidence.publisher: ACTE national commune energy-transition programme implemented by ANME
primaryEvidence.finding: Explicitly identifies Douz as a city in Kebili and describes urban growth over agricultural land, oasis/tourism activity and industrial infrastructure. This identifies an inhabited city rather than merely a municipality office.

publisherSupport.finding: ANME procurement documentation identifies ANME implementation of ACTE, lists Douz among pilot communes and distinguishes programme activities from municipal objects.

primaryEvidence.limits: Neither the general city profile nor programme procurement establishes Douz North/South boundaries. Those current separate sectors and contexts remain intact.

primaryEvidence.publisher: Tunisian Ministry of Equipment, Housing and Territorial Planning, Urban Hydraulics Directorate
primaryEvidence.finding: Official tender06/2017 explicitly assigns lot2 to city flood-protection works in Jemmal, alongside separate Sousse and Zeramdine city works. This establishes city identity without conflating any named imada with the whole town.
primaryEvidence.limits: No geographical extent or delegation population is imported. The municipal PGES lead could be indexed by web search, but direct archival access timed out; it is supplementary discovery only, not a pinned PDF source.
